Info

Defines MoveEvent domain model representing firmware motion execution event.

class scarajectory.core.model.telemetry.move_event.MoveEvent(*, event_type: int, segment_id: int)[source]¶

Bases: object

Domain model representing asynchronous motion execution events dispatched by firmware.

It defines:

attributes:
event_type - Event type identifier (1=START, 2=DONE, 3=FAILED).
segment_id - Monotonic trajectory segment sequence counter.
